metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Hardware Capability Profile
metadata.description: Hardware capability declaration for conceptual accelerators implementing FFT AI substrate and kernels.

hardware_profile.notes: This profile describes hardware capable of executing FFT AI substrate kernels and enforcing RTT invariants at silicon or firmware level.

limits.notes: Values are conceptual placeholders; concrete implementations may refine numeric limits.

control_plane.description: Firmware-level control interface for configuring regimes, invariants, and validation profiles.

data_plane.description: Streaming interface for signals and clarity metrics.

compatibility.notes: Hardware must be able to load and interpret the FFT AI substrate, spec, and registry to be considered fully compatible.
